title: A validated review result is stranded when its parent is lost before the explicit attempt read: eligible roots can neither publish it nor discover its resultId
outcome: A review that ended with a validated submission can be recovered by an eligible root of the same project even when the commissioning parent was lost before it read the result, without weakening read-only eligibility or exact-identity reads.
acceptance: A review attempt that reaches a validated terminal state is published, or otherwise becomes readable, without depending on the parent's explicit submissionAttempt read or follow-up

An eligible root of the original project can discover the exact delegationId, submissionAttempt and resultId of such a result through a supported read-only route, while a child, hidden or removed session, proxy or root of another project still can't

A deterministic test covers a parent lost before any explicit read: discovery and exact read succeed for an eligible root and stay refused for an ineligible one, and an attempt-only read keeps its existing refusal
